BrochureContent.Content:
This well-presented three-bedroom mid-terraced residence is ideally located just a short stroll from the highly sought-after coastal town of Kilkee on the stunning west coast of County Clare. Offered in good condition throughout, the property provides an excellent opportunity for those seeking a permanent home, holiday retreat, or investment property in one of Clare’s most popular seaside locations.

Kilkee is a charming and picturesque town, renowned for its beautiful horseshoe-shaped beach which forms the focal point of the town. Residents and visitors alike can enjoy a wonderful selection of cafés, restaurants, traditional pubs, breathtaking cliff walks, and a wide range of water-based activities including swimming, surfing, and kayaking.

Internally, the accommodation is bright and functional, comprising a kitchen, a comfortable living room, three bedrooms, and a main family bathroom.

To the rear, the property benefits from a spacious concrete yard, offering ample outdoor space for entertaining, storage, or everyday use. A detached garage provides additional storage or workshop potential. A particularly attractive feature is the rear access via a small laneway, allowing convenient access to the yard and garage.

Combining a superb coastal location with practical living space and excellent external features, this property is sure to appeal to a wide range of purchasers looking to enjoy all that Kilkee and the Wild Atlantic Way have to offer.
